name: BASILISK
author: optim-agent
description:
Base re-encoding. Clue is 'DIGITS:FROM>TO' e.g. '1f4:16>7': read DIGITS in base FROM and
write the same value in base TO, lowercase, no leading zero. Value is 20..5000, bases 2..16.
DIFFICULTY: easy (deliberate freebie / morale anchor).
DISCOVERY PATH: BASilisk hides 'base'; the clue is nearly self-documenting and one demo
settles direction (FROM>TO, not TO>FROM) and the lowercase/no-leading-zero convention.
The scorer uses int(s,base) inside try/except so junk simply scores 0.
generate:
def generate(seed):
    r = random.Random(seed)
    n = r.randrange(20, 5000)
    a = r.choice([2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 16])
    b = r.choice([x for x in [2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 16] if x != a])
    d = '0123456789abcdef'
    v, s = n, ''
    while v:
        s = d[v % a] + s
        v //= a
    return s + ':' + str(a) + '>' + str(b)
solve:
def solve(clue):
    v, b = clue.split('>')
    n, a = v.split(':')
    x = int(n, int(a))
    b = int(b)
    d = '0123456789abcdef'
    s = ''
    while x:
        s = d[x % b] + s
        x //= b
    return s or '0'
